prompt: Use case: stylized-concept. Asset type: ONE original premium transparent collectible playing-card sticker for BALÍK / PANELÁK 3000. Input image role: STYLE REFERENCE ONLY. One arm raises a chunky pinwheel; the other tips a tiny copper tea kettle that contains a single sculpted cloud curl. Strong S-curve pose, no generic tablet. World: Střechy. Physically dimensional rounded sculpting, deliberately designed proportions, asymmetric silhouettes, specific expressive faces where appropriate, hand-shaped imperfections. Distinguish satin enamel, worn brass, brushed metal, soft rubber, canvas, plush fabric and concrete. Card role: Kapitán; the rank is only a visual archetype, do not show letters or numbers. Clear big forms readable at 64px, rich selective craftsmanship at 160–300px, one visual focal point. A narrow opaque warm ivory die-cut edge tightly follows the irregular silhouette, subtle tight edge shadow. No rectangular background, floor plane, scenery extending to the edge, display plinth unrelated to the subject, card bitmap, indices, suit symbols, lettering, numerals, signs, logos or watermark.
